author: unknown
content:
[Advice] There is a level of work that makes failing impossible, stop looking for shortcuts.
 

You shouldn't read this now. You got work to do... And you came here for a "pep talk"...

Your life is average in all areas and you still need a pep talk.... Get serious.

I highly doubt our fathers and grandfathers had to watch motivational clips to get themselves going to work so they could provide for living.

Watching self-help content without action is useless and it's just a form of procrastination.

I want you guys to imagine what would the most disciplined version of you be doing right now.

***Stop procrastinating on the man you want to become.***
